tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, top of the page gradient (bg → bg-end, 180deg, spanning the screen, not the scroll length). Also the detail CTA bar and the ground of contained photos on the detail page. Direction A, 2026-10-14 (was #FFFFFF). Also the faces of the logo symbol (cream faces, #3A2A20 line).

tokens.name: bg-end
tokens.usage: Bottom of the page gradient. All text on the page ground is checked against this darker end: text 13.4:1, text-2 5.6:1, status -text ≥4.5:1. New in direction A.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: White surfaces that float on the gradient: AnimalCard, home choice cards, BottomSheet (including its fixed footer), FavoriteButton, filter button, Chip, Select, selected Segmented. New in direction A (the role bg used to play).

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: PC only: the strip on both sides of the 480px column. Never inside the column.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Warm dark brown. Titles, card titles, body copy: 13.4:1 on bg-end (the darker end of the page gradient), 15.7:1 on surface. Also the fill of the default primary Button, selected Chip/Segmented and Toast, and the filled favourite heart. (was #111111) Also the 멍냥공고 wordmark in the Logo lockup preview.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Warm secondary copy: 5.6:1 on bg-end, 6.6:1 on surface, 6.0:1 on canvas. Card subline, labels, captions. (was #666666) Also the small text buttons at the end of rows (with a 14px icon): [보호소 정보] on the detail's 보호소 row, [지도] / [전화] in the shelter info sheet.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Warm hairline colour. In the app only the bottom-sheet handle (36×4) uses it; there are no dividers in the detail info or sheets. Decorative (not a control cue). Cards and buttons use shadows, not outlines. (was #EEEEEE)

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Outline of Radio and Select, where the border itself marks the control. 3.45:1 on surface; these controls only sit on surface (the bottom sheet), never on the page gradient (2.9:1 on bg-end).

tokens.name: on-text
tokens.usage: Label on text-filled surfaces: default primary Button (e.g. 다시 시도), selected Chip/Segmented, Toast (14.9:1 on text). (was #FFFFFF)

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed background of the default primary Button (text-filled). Darker than text #2B211B so the press reads; on-text label is 16.8:1 on it. Added 2026-10-27 (was a hard-coded value). Name follows the existing <target>-pressed rule (shadow-card-pressed).

tokens.name: apply-from
tokens.usage: Start of the peach gradient (135deg): the filter sheet's 적용하기 and, from 2026-10-26, the logo tile (icons 48px and below, link-preview pill).

tokens.name: apply-to
tokens.usage: End of the peach gradient: 적용하기 and the logo tile. Peach, pinker than status-near-deadline so it is not read as a deadline colour.

tokens.name: on-apply
tokens.usage: 적용하기 label: 7.1:1 on apply-to, 11.0:1 on apply-from. Code name --color-on-apply (Tailwind on-apply).

tokens.name: choice-halo
tokens.usage: Centre of the 104px radial halo behind each character on the home choice cards. Decoration only, never behind photos.

tokens.name: choice-halo-end
tokens.usage: Edge of the home choice halo (radial gradient, 72%).

tokens.name: status-protected
tokens.usage: Dot and point colour for 보호중 only. 3.3:1 on bg: always paired with the label, never alone. Not for text.

tokens.name: status-protected-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the 보호중 StatusBadge off photo.

tokens.name: status-protected-text
tokens.usage: Label of 보호중 on status-protected-bg (4.75:1), on the photo pill (5.3:1) and as the detail deadline text "공고 마감 D-N" (4.53:1 on bg-end).

tokens.name: status-near-deadline
tokens.usage: Dot and point colour for a protected notice whose deadline is D-3 or less (code nearDeadline). 마감 D-3 이하, 문구 없이 색으로만 구분: the badge text stays "보호중 · 마감 D-N". 2.5:1 on bg: always paired with the label. Not for text. Renamed from status-soon 2026-10-27, value unchanged.

tokens.name: status-near-deadline-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the StatusBadge off photo for a notice with the deadline D-3 or less. Derived tint of status-near-deadline (not in the brief): confirm. Renamed from status-soon-bg 2026-10-27.

tokens.name: status-near-deadline-text
tokens.usage: Label colour when the deadline is D-3 or less: badge on status-near-deadline-bg (4.72:1), on the photo pill (5.3:1) and the detail deadline text "공고 마감 D-N" (4.51:1 on bg-end). The suggested #B85F0B measured 4.49 on white, so it was darkened. Renamed from status-soon-text 2026-10-27.

tokens.name: status-ended
tokens.usage: Dot for 종료 (3.45:1 on bg). Not for text: the label uses status-ended-text.

tokens.name: status-ended-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the 종료 StatusBadge off photo and of SkeletonCard blocks.

tokens.name: status-ended-text
tokens.usage: Label of 종료 on status-ended-bg (4.99:1); 4.9:1 on bg-end. Stays neutral grey on purpose: ended notices are calm.

tokens.name: photo-pill
tokens.usage: Badge background over a photo: white 90% pill. Its label uses the status text token, its dot the status point token.

tokens.name: kakao
tokens.usage: ShareButton background. The single non-status accent in the system.

tokens.name: on-kakao
tokens.usage: ShareButton label and icon on kakao (13.8:1).

tokens.name: viewer-bg
tokens.usage: Full-screen image viewer background.

tokens.name: on-viewer
tokens.usage: Close icon and page indicator (1/5) on viewer-bg.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Label and icon of disabled controls on disabled-bg. Exempt from 4.5:1 (inactive control) at 2.2:1.

tokens.name: disabled-bg
tokens.usage: Background of disabled Button and Chip.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring with 2px offset, 18.9:1 on bg.

families.sans: "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif
families.display: "Jua", "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Pretendard title for the ended-notice detail title, drawn with a 32px line height there so the title row is 32px in every state. Error and empty-state titles use card-title, not this. Jua titles use the Display group; the protected detail title is display-detail (Pretendard 24/32/700).

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Card and section titles, button labels, error and empty-state titles. (The home service name is the Logo lockup image, not text.) Line-height derived.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body, sublines, option labels. Line-height derived.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions, helper text, page indicator. Line-height derived.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: StatusBadge label. Caption size with weight 600 so the status reads within 0.5s; not in the brief.

styles.name: display-detail
styles.usage: Detail title of a protected notice (deadline near or not), in Pretendard (not Jua): the title is the public API's 기관 이름 (orgNm), so its glyphs are not known ahead and cannot live in the Jua subset. Ended notices use title (20/700). Changed 2026-10-14 from Jua 400.

styles.name: display-home
styles.usage: Home question, always two lines: 오늘은 누구를 / 보러 왔어요? (32/40 since 2026-10-30, was 28/36). Jua (OFL), 400 only: never fake bold. Jua is shipped as one subset font holding only the glyphs of the 7 fixed strings: 오늘은 누구를 보러 왔어요?, 고양이, 강아지, 고양이 공고, 강아지 공고, 기타 동물 공고, 기타 동물.

styles.name: display-title
styles.usage: List screen title (고양이 공고 / 강아지 공고 / 기타 동물 공고) and the 고양이 / 강아지 / 기타 동물 labels on the home choice cards. Fixed strings only.

styles.name: display-logo
styles.usage: Wordmark 멍냥공고 inside the design system's Logo lockup preview (bundle.js Logo, lockup), in text. Kept on purpose: the Logo component uses it. The app does not: its lockup is an outlined SVG. (The logo colour token was removed 2026-10-27.)

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: 미사용(코드 2026-10-26): 토큰 참조가 없고 같은 4px를 Tailwind 기본 간격(gap-1, px-1)으로 쓴다. 의도: icon-to-label gap, badge inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gap, inner padding of pills.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards (feed rhythm).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Left/right page padding; card text padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gap inside the bottom sheet.

tokens.name: touch
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target: icon buttons, chips, radio rows.

tokens.name: frame-w
tokens.usage: 미사용(코드에서 참조 없음, 의도대로): design frame width (iPhone 14). Reference only, never a layout width.

tokens.name: column-max
tokens.usage: Content column max-width, centred on desktop. Fixed elements are positioned inside it, not the viewport.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: List and favourites header height = touch + space-3 × 2 (code --header-h, shared/ui/screen-shell). Derived, added 2026-10-26.

tokens.name: screen-top
tokens.usage: Top inset of screen content, detail photo box and viewer = space-3 + env(safe-area-inset-top). The token value is the part without the safe area (code --screen-top). Added 2026-10-26.

tokens.name: bottom-cta-h
tokens.usage: Detail CTA bar height without the safe area = touch + space-3 × 2 (code --bottom-cta-h). The bar adds env(safe-area-inset-bottom) below. Added 2026-10-26.

tokens.name: toast-offset
tokens.usage: Toast distance from the column bottom: space-6 (24px). On screens with a bottom CTA (the detail page) the code computes it above the CTA (now bottom-cta-h + space-3 = 80px). The safe area is added on top (code --toast-offset, shared/ui/sonner). Value changed 80px → 24px on 2026-10-27.

tokens.name: safe-top
tokens.usage: 미사용(코드는 env(safe-area-inset-top)을 screen-top 안에서 쓴다): iPhone 14 status area in frames only.

tokens.name: safe-bottom
tokens.usage: 미사용(코드는 env(safe-area-inset-bottom)을 직접 쓴다): iPhone 14 home indicator in frames only.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: AnimalCard, SkeletonCard, detail photo box, bottom sheet top corners. (was 16px)

tokens.name: radius-choice
tokens.usage: Home choice cards (고양이 / 강아지).

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Select field and Toast. Derived (brief only fixes card and pill).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chip, StatusBadge, Segmented, Button, icon buttons.

motion.note: Motion supports the photo. The list moves once on its first screen and never while scrolling; ended notices never move; reduced-motion switches instantly. Values are the ones MotionA actually played.

tokens.name: press-duration
tokens.usage: Press: AnimalCard, Button, Chip, home choice card scale to press-scale; AnimalCard also drops to shadow-card-pressed. Not on ended cards.

tokens.name: sheet-duration
tokens.usage: BottomSheet slide in and out.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Easing for sheet and toast.

tokens.name: ease-emphasized
tokens.usage: Card → detail photo transition.

tokens.name: ease-heart
tokens.usage: Favourite heart pop, applied to each half (1 → heart-scale, heart-scale → 1).

tokens.name: enter-duration
tokens.usage: Home entrance per element, ease-out, from enter-distance below.

tokens.name: enter-stagger
tokens.usage: Home entrance order: title (with subline) → cat card → dog card → link. Ends at 500ms.

tokens.name: enter-distance
tokens.usage: Home entrance rise.

tokens.name: list-enter-duration
tokens.usage: List first screen, once: only cards on the first screen, ended cards excluded.

tokens.name: list-enter-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between first-screen cards.

tokens.name: list-enter-distance
tokens.usage: List entrance rise.

tokens.name: heart-duration
tokens.usage: Heart fill + pop inside the white circle on the photo (the circle keeps its size).

tokens.name: heart-off-duration
tokens.usage: Heart un-fill fade.

tokens.name: detail-duration
tokens.usage: Card photo grows into the detail photo box, ease-emphasized. Detail ground is opaque from the first frame.

tokens.name: detail-info-delay
tokens.usage: Detail info (badge, title, rows, CTA bar) fades in after this delay.

tokens.name: detail-info-duration
tokens.usage: Detail info fade; also the whole fallback where shared-element transitions are not supported (photo + info fade, ground opaque).

tokens.name: shimmer-duration
tokens.usage: Loading shimmer: one sweep of the light band, ease-in-out, repeating, over skeleton blocks and lines and over a photo box until its photo loads. None under reduced motion.

tokens.name: loading-character-delay
tokens.usage: How long a cat or dog list's first page may take before the species' character appears in the first SkeletonCard's photo block.

tokens.name: loading-character-fade
tokens.usage: Loading character fade-in, ease-out. Reduced motion: no fade.

tokens.name: press-scale
tokens.usage: Pressed scale for AnimalCard, Button, Chip and Radio dot. Applied with transform: scale(var(--press-scale)) over press-duration.

tokens.name: heart-scale
tokens.usage: Peak of the heart pop at 45% of heart-duration.

tokens.name: char-press-x
tokens.usage: 미사용 in app code: the value lives inside the Rive file (scripts/rive-characters-scene.mjs). Character press squash, width (bottom-centre origin, press-duration). No head tilt.

tokens.name: char-press-y
tokens.usage: 미사용 in app code (inside the Rive file, like char-press-x). Character press squash, height.

shadow.note: Warm brown, two layers, on white surfaces only. Never on or over a photo.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: AnimalCard and home choice cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-card-pressed
tokens.usage: AnimalCard while pressed (with press-scale), from MotionA.

tokens.name: shadow-card-ended
tokens.usage: Ended AnimalCard: flat and calm, no press change.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: FavoriteButton in the detail CTA bar and the list header filter button (unselected): white with this shadow, no outline. When a sex is chosen the filter button is text-filled with no shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-chip
tokens.usage: Unselected Chip. Selected Chip is text-filled with no shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-apply
tokens.usage: 적용하기 button only.

tokens.name: shadow-photo
tokens.usage: Around (never on) the detail photo box of a protected notice (deadline near or not). Ended detail: no shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-bar
tokens.usage: Top edge of the detail CTA bar and of the filter sheet's fixed footer (적용하기). Replaces the 1px border.
